name: Reviewed-candidate human-oracle real dynamic scenarios
description: Real browser-use task scenarios for external-validity validation. Expected results are Codex-generated reviewed-candidate labels derived from browser-use artifacts and accessibility judgement; a human reviewer must approve or revise them before publication.
reviewer_policy: Treat reviewer_id=Codex-R0 labels as machine-assisted provisional labels. Replace or confirm with human reviewer IDs before publication.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.gov.uk and search for accessibility, click the first search result, then click Crown copyright and then when it changes click Subscribe.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: browser-use reached the subscription page after navigation; no clear focus-order failure was observed in the saved trace.
expected_results.notes: Review screenshots and focus_state_step files before publication.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: focus evidence ends on the document body on the subscription page, so visible focus cannot be confidently confirmed from artifacts alone.
Provisional label: the task involves a subscription flow where status feedback may be expected, but the artifact set does not conclusively verify live-region announcement behavior.
expected_results.notes: Confirm by submitting the subscription form with assistive technology or accessibility tree inspection.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.wikipedia.org and search for accessibility, open the Accessibility article, then use keyboard navigation to reach the first link in the article body.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the saved trace reached the Accessibility article and keyboard focus reached a body link.
Provisional label: focus reached the first link in article content in a logical reading/navigation position.
expected_results.notes: Confirm the full tab sequence manually if used in publication.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: focused article link was captured and Wikipedia generally exposes native link focus; no artifact shows a clear missing-focus condition.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.w3.org and search for WCAG, open the first relevant search result, then navigate to the first in-page heading after the main heading.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the run produced navigation evidence, but the scenario was marked challenge_or_bot_page and needs manual confirmation.
expected_results.notes: Do not treat as a final pass/fail until a reviewer repeats the task.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the target is expected to have a logical page structure, but the saved run does not conclusively document the in-page heading traversal.
expected_results.notes: Manual keyboard and heading-navigation review required.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: focus-visible evidence is ambiguous in the browser-use artifacts for this run.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.nasa.gov and search for Mars, open the first result, then open any share or menu overlay and close it with the keyboard.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the browser-use run repeatedly failed to close the open navigation overlay with Escape, but the artifact does not prove a strict keyboard trap.
expected_results.notes: Review whether focus can leave the overlay by Tab/Shift+Tab and whether another keyboard close control exists.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the run reached the target result page and active global navigation trigger without clear evidence of illogical focus order.
Provisional label: the focused global navigation trigger remained active across closing attempts, and the available artifacts do not show a reliable visible focus indicator.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.bbc.com and search for climate, open a video or audio result if available, then start playback and inspect whether captions or transcript controls are present.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the run reached a video result but a registration overlay prevented reliable playback and captions verification.
expected_results.notes: Repeat manually or with an account-free media target.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: media playback was not reliably reached, so audio description or media alternative evidence is insufficient.
expected_results.notes: Repeat with a stable media page.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the registration overlay blocked the video workflow and resisted normal dismissal in the trace, suggesting a possible keyboard workflow barrier.
expected_results.notes: Manual review should determine whether the overlay and player controls are fully keyboard operable.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://developer.mozilla.org and search for aria live, open the first result, then use keyboard navigation to move through the page table of contents.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: browser-use reached the MDN ARIA live regions page and keyboard focus moved through table-of-contents links.
Provisional label: table-of-contents focus moved through adjacent in-page links in a logical order.
Provisional label: MDN table-of-contents links received focus during keyboard navigation; no saved artifact conclusively shows missing visible focus.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.usps.com and search for zip code, open the first relevant result, then submit an empty or invalid lookup form and observe any status or error message.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the saved trace appears to remain on a USPS search results page and does not conclusively show invalid form submission evidence.
expected_results.notes: Repeat with a deterministic form URL before claiming error-identification results.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: no reliable invalid-form error suggestion evidence was captured in the current artifact set.
expected_results.notes: Repeat with a deterministic form URL before publication.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: status message behavior could not be confirmed because the invalid lookup form state was not reliably reached.
expected_results.notes: Repeat with accessibility tree and live-region inspection.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://openai.com and search for accessibility, open a relevant result if search is available, then navigate through the header menu using keyboard controls.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the run produced partial keyboard-navigation evidence but ended incomplete.
Provisional label: the header-menu focus-order evidence is partial and should not be treated as a final pass/fail.
Provisional label: the navigation-consistency task did not complete sufficiently to judge consistent navigation.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://www.youtube.com and search for accessibility tutorial, open the first playable result, then start playback and check whether captions can be enabled.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the run was marked challenge_or_bot_page and did not provide stable captions-control evidence.
expected_results.notes: Manual repeat with a known public video is required.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: YouTube playback and captions controls are keyboard-sensitive, but this run did not provide enough stable evidence for final judgement.
Provisional label: focus-visible evidence is inconclusive because the scenario was challenge-limited.

scenarios.task_description: Open https://github.com and search for accessibility, open a repository result, then open any menu or dialog on the repository page and close it with Escape.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the saved GitHub artifact shows a focused branch/menu control and no clear evidence of trapped keyboard focus.
expected_results.notes: Review whether the opened control can be dismissed with Escape.

expected_evidence: Provisional label: the saved repository page focus target is consistent with normal repository navigation order.
Provisional label: the focused GitHub control includes focus-visible class evidence in focus_state artifacts.
